title: Validator documentation update
body:
Hi, validators!

I am proposing an update to the validator documentation to make it easier for other people who want to run a validator for Edgeware. I have included links to the current and proposed documentation.

What we have now.
[https://www.edgeware.wiki/quickstart/set-up-a-validator](https://www.edgeware.wiki/quickstart/set-up-a-validator)

What I am proposing would look like.
[https://new-edgeware-docs-git-fork-depth-hoar-main-edgeware-agency.vercel.app/quickstart/set-up-a-validator](https://new-edgeware-docs-git-fork-depth-hoar-main-edgeware-agency.vercel.app/quickstart/set-up-a-validator)

I have also included the raw markdown so you can read it below. You can share your feedback on this thread or on the pull request directly here [https://github.com/edgeware-network/new-edgeware-docs/pull/30](https://github.com/edgeware-network/new-edgeware-docs/pull/30)



#** Set Up a Validator**

Welcome to the official, in-depth Edgeware guide to validating. We're happy that you're interested in validating on Edgeware and we'll do our best to provide in-depth documentation on the process below. As always, reach out on [Discord]([https://discord.gg/mYk543EXBV](https://discord.gg/mYk543EXBV)) or [Telegram]([https://t.me/heyedgeware](https://t.me/heyedgeware)) if you have questions about the project.

This document contains all the information one should need to start validating on Edgeware using the **command line interface**. We will start with how to setup one's node and proceed to how to key management and monitoring. To start, we will use the following terminology of keys for the guide:

- _****stash****_ - the stash keypair is where most of your funds should be located. It can be kept in cold storage if necessary.
- _****controller****_ - the controller is the keypair that will control your validator settings. It should have a smaller balance, e.g. 10-100 EDG
